SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. ............
No. S. B. D. 80/0
S.1, Special Branch Station 37
Date July 22, 1937.

REPORT

Subject Michel Shikis, applicant for a visé to the Netherlands Indies.

Made by D.S. McKeown Forwarded by C Crawford D.I.

Michel Shikis, applicant for a visé to the Nether-
lands Indies, Russian Jew by birth and Greek subject, prior
to 1920 resided in Vladivostok, where he acquired an unsavoury
reputation as a dealer in second hand goods. After arriving
in Shanghai he first came to notice in 1921 when he requested
assistance from a member of the Shanghai Municipal Police.
It appears that a friend of Shikis brought a quantity of
cocaine to Shanghai which was confiscated by a Customs official
whereupon Shikis otherwise known as Shiks who alleged that the
Customs official was going to sell the cocaine appealed to a
member of the Shanghai Municipal Police to frighten the
official into returning the cocaine. From 1921 onwards
Shikis has existed precariously as a lawyer and journalist.
In the former connection, he has been associated with with
M. Paul Tremet, and during the Joseph Walden case, acted as
mouth piece for M. Tremet. Of late, it would appear that he
has executed a complete volte-face. He is now a leader of
the local Seventh Day Adventists, and to all intents and
purposes, a perfectly reputable member of the local community.

McKeown
D. S.

D.C. (Special Branch)
22/7.

报告

事由：米歇尔·希基斯（Michel Shikis），申请前往荷属东印度群岛的签证。

撰写人：D.S. 麦基翁（McKeown） 转呈人：C. 克劳福德（Crawford），督察

米歇尔·希基斯，申请前往荷属东印度群岛的签证，系俄裔犹太人，希腊籍公民。1920年之前居住于符拉迪沃斯托克（Vladivostok），在那里他作为一名二手货商人名声不佳。抵达上海后，他于1921年首次引起注意，当时他请求一名上海公共租界工部局警务处警员提供协助。据悉，希基斯的一位朋友将一批可卡因带入上海，被海关官员没收；随后，希基斯（又名 Shiks）声称该海关官员打算出售这批可卡因，遂向一名上海公共租界工部局警务处警员求助，企图恐吓该官员归还可卡因。自1921年以来，希基斯一直勉强以律师和记者的身份谋生。在律师身份方面，他与保罗·特雷梅特（Paul Tremet）先生有往来，并在约瑟夫·沃尔登（Joseph Walden）一案中充当特雷梅特先生的代言人。近来，他似乎发生了彻底的转变。他现在是本地基督复临安息日会（Seventh Day Adventists）的领袖，并且无论从哪方面看，都是本地社区中一位完全体面的成员。

麦基翁
D. S.

副总监（特务科）
22/7。

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No.2315.                                SHANGHAI,    15th   July   1937 80/0
                                                                          16 - 37

Sir,

      I have the honour to inform you that Mr.Michel SHIKIS has
applied to this Consulate for a visé for admission into the
Netherlands Indies.

      He is in possession of a passport issued by the Greece
Consulate at Shanghai on the 12th July 1937, valid for one year,
No.225.

      Mr.Shikis, a lawyer and journalist, is connected with the
Silver Jubilee Publishing Co.Ltd.,11 Edward Ezra Road, and will
accompany Mr.B.A.Topas on his trip round the world. (Vide my
letter of June 7th 1937,No.1368).

      Mr.Shikis is residing at 828 Weihaiwei Road.

      The trip of Mr.Topas has been delayed, however, they intend
to leave in the course of this month.

      I should be much obliged to you if you would let me know,
if possible, whether anything is known against this person from
a political or moral point of view.

                                          I have the honour to be,

                                                  Sir,

                                          Your obedient servant,

                                          (签名)

                                          Vice-Consul.


Major K.M.Bourne,
Officer i/c Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
        SHANGHAI.

                                        S.I.          S/B.
                                        (签名)
                                         7/7          (印：COMMISSIONER OF POLICE
                                                       m/o
                                                       16 JULY 1937
                                                       * SHANGHAI *)

荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电报挂号 HOLLANDIA。

编号 2315。                                上海，    1937年7月15日 80/0
                                                                          16 - 37

先生：

      谨此通知阁下，米歇尔·希基斯（Michel SHIKIS）先生已向本领事馆申请进入荷属东印度群岛的签证。

      他持有希腊驻上海领事馆于1937年7月12日签发的护照，有效期一年，编号225。

      希基斯先生是一名律师兼记者，与爱多亚路11号的银禧出版有限公司（Silver Jubilee Publishing Co.Ltd.）有关联，并将陪同 B.A. 托帕斯（B.A.Topas）先生进行环球旅行。（参见我1937年6月7日的第1368号信函）。

      希基斯先生现居住于威海卫路828号。

      托帕斯先生的行程已推迟，但他们计划在本月内启程。

      如蒙告知，从政治或道德角度来看，是否掌握对此人不利的情况，我将不胜感激。

                                          谨此致意，

                                                  先生，

                                          您顺从的仆人，

                                          （签名）

                                          副领事。


K.M. 伯恩少校，
特务科主管，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
        上海。

                                        S.I.          S/B.
                                        （签名）
                                         7/7          （印章：警务总监
                                                       m/o
                                                       1937年7月16日
                                                       * 上海 *）
